text:
maria_pm: Quick sync — need to order quantization, batching, caching for Optimize toolkit roadmap. We have enterprise asks and cost pressure. Thoughts?

jon_engineer: my gut says quantization first. biggest unit-cost savings, doable on model packaging side.

lee_ml: +1 on cost impact, but quality/regression risk. we need an eval harness gated into rollout.

sam_solutions: customer A (fintech) asked for deterministic latency improvements — caching their common prompts would help them immediately. they're pushing for caching on private deployments.

maria_pm: ok — so three major signals: cost (quant), throughput (batching), latency/enterprise (caching). want to run a quick RICE to prioritize.

jon_engineer: can we do a quick back-of-envelope? I'll toss rough numbers:
```
Feature      Reach  Impact  Confidence  Effort (sprints)
Quantization   6      7        6         3
Batching       5      6        7         4
Caching        3      5        6         2
```

lee_ml: math: RICE = (Reach*Impact*Confidence)/Effort — rough results: quant ~84, batching ~52.5, caching ~45.

sam_solutions: those scores align with business: quant first, but caching required for that one enterprise deal. can we split work into an enterprise-focused caching MVP while we do quant?

devops_ben: note: caching on private requires infra changes (stateful cache, eviction policies, KMS integration). that's not trivial but doable in 2 sprints if scoped tightly.

maria_pm: proposal: parallel tracks — 1) quantization MVP for open/hosted models (3 sprints) with eval gating; 2) small caching MVP for private deployments focused on prefix/KV caching for templated prompts (2 sprints); 3) batching improvements as follow-up (4 sprints) focusing on continuous batching and autoscale knobs.

jon_engineer: implementation risk: quantization for decoder-only vs encoder-decoder differs; we should pick the highest-usage model family first. recommend starting with the redwood-base family (most traffic).

lee_ml: also add canary/rollout criteria: quality regression <=1% on key prompt suite, latency within 5% of baseline for p99 for critical paths. otherwise rollback.

sam_solutions: accept. also add an enterprise toggle for caching + docs + privacy checklist. they need audit log and KMS support.

maria_pm: can we capture action items?

jon_engineer: Action: prototype quant pipeline + quant profiles (owner: jon) — 3 sprints.

lee_ml: Action: build eval harness + prompt suite for regression gating (owner: lee) — parallel, 2 sprints.

devops_ben: Action: design private caching MVP infra and security checklist (owner: ben) — 2 sprints.

sam_solutions: Action: customer comms + enterprise requirements doc (owner: sam) — 1 sprint.

maria_pm: cool. final question: do we need to reprioritize other work? any hard blockers?

jon_engineer: only thing that blocks quant is getting model artifacts and test tokens — should be available. batching needs more coordination with runtime team but can be queued.

lee_ml: we'll schedule eval runs daily and post results to the QA dashboard. if regressions exceed threshold, we pause rollout.

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary rollout window for quant prototype set for 1865680000-1865766400 (ETA after prototype).

maria_pm: thanks team. I'll update the roadmap doc and create tickets for the actions. Ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:

jon_engineer: noted, starting prototype today.

sam_solutions: will draft enterprise brief by EOD.

lee_ml: starting eval harness today.

devops_ben: will share infra design draft tomorrow.

maria_pm: meeting adjourned — will circle back in next stand.
